scenario: Successful user registration with valid credentials
assertions: Assert 201 Created status code
Validate response body contains user ID and success message
Verify user is created in the database (if accessible)
Assert no sensitive information like password is returned

scenario: Registration with an already existing email address
assertions: Assert 409 Conflict or 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message indicates duplicate email

scenario: Registration with missing required fields (e.g., email, password)
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message specifies missing fields

scenario: Registration with an invalid email format
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message indicates invalid email format

scenario: Registration with a weak password (e.g., too short, common password)
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message indicates password policy violation

scenario: Registration with excessively long input fields (e.g., name, email)
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message indicates field length violation

scenario: Successful user login with valid credentials
assertions: Assert 200 OK status code
Validate response body contains an authentication token (JWT, session ID)
Verify token has expected claims/structure
Assert no sensitive information like password is returned

scenario: Login with incorrect password for an existing user
assertions: Assert 401 Unauthorized status code
Validate error message indicates invalid credentials

scenario: Login with a non-existent email address
assertions: Assert 401 Unauthorized status code
Validate error message indicates invalid credentials (to prevent user enumeration)

scenario: Login with missing credentials (e.g., empty email or password)
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message specifies missing fields

scenario: Login with an account that is locked or disabled
assertions: Assert 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden status code
Validate error message indicates account status

scenario: Rate limit test: Multiple failed login attempts
assertions: Assert 429 Too Many Requests status code after threshold
Verify subsequent requests are blocked for a period

scenario: Successful user logout with a valid token
assertions: Assert 200 OK or 204 No Content status code
Verify the authentication token is invalidated on the server side (subsequent requests with token fail)

scenario: Logout attempt without an active session/token
assertions: Assert 401 Unauthorized or 400 Bad Request status code
Validate error message indicates no active session

scenario: Retrieve all users as an administrator
assertions: Assert 200 OK status code
Validate response is a JSON array of user objects
Verify response contains expected number of users
Assert sensitive information (e.g., passwords) is not exposed

scenario: Attempt to retrieve all users as a regular authenticated user (unauthorized)
assertions: Assert 403 Forbidden status code
Validate error message indicates insufficient permissions

scenario: Attempt to retrieve all users as an unauthenticated user
assertions: Assert 401 Unauthorized status code
Validate error message indicates missing authentication

scenario: Retrieve a specific user by valid ID as an administrator
